reuse.why: Extends the existing shared getDateWithSkippedWeekend with a holidays parameter and replaces every raw isWeekend check with one new shared predicate.

duplication.why: No logic is copied, but the pre-existing per-site skipWeekend/daily 'drop vs move' decision stays repeated in four places and each now threads holidays by hand.

placement.why: isNonWorkingDay and the movement loop live in shared/schedules.ts next to the existing weekend helper, and server sites only call them.

scope.why: Focused on the feature; the only extra is reformatting the two nextDate ternaries in schedule-template.ts.

maintainability.why: One predicate defines a non-working day, though callers must remember to pass holidays at each site and the holidayMargin look-around in getDatesInRange is an ad hoc heuristic.

one_place.where: packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts isNonWorkingDay (used by getDateWithSkippedWeekend, getNextDate, getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange and schedule-template), with holidays passed through from each config
